meaning.en: Lasting for a short period of time; short-term.

sentences.en: At the point where you meet the road there is a short run of stone balustrade on your right by the end shop.

sentences.en: Fasting, skipping meals, and overly restrictive diets will enable you to lose weight in the short run.

sentences.en: Finally, a forward-looking interpretation of the short-run dynamics, assuming quadratic adjustment costs, cannot be rejected by the data.
